features.name: Nature's Wrath / Turn the Faithless
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you ensnare enemies with vines or turn Fey and Fiends (as with Turn Undead).

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.desc: You and allies within 10 feet gain Resistance to damage from spells.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.desc: When you drop to 0 Hit Points (and aren't killed), you drop to 1 Hit Point instead (once per Long Rest).

features.name: Elder Champion
features.desc: As an action, for 1 minute: regeneration, Advantage for you and Disadvantage for enemies, and you can cast level 1-2 Paladin spells as a Bonus Action.
